steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Design a hypothesis and sampling strategy to investigate how footpath erosion varies with distance from a car park in a national park --- Solution: Hypothesis: Footpath erosion decreases with distance from car park due to visitor pressure decay. Systematic sampling: measure path width, depth, vegetation cover every 50m along 1km transect. Risk: weather, terrain. Ethics: minimise disturbance
